_readme: HAND-AUTHORED SMOKE-TEST SET -- this is NOT a published benchmark and carries
no research authority. It exists so the harness has something to run on day one.
Claims were chosen to be uncontroversially adjudicated: the SUPPORTED items are
well-documented events, the REFUTED items are misinformation with extensive
public debunking. The synthetic_control items are invented and should retrieve
nothing -- they test that the system ABSTAINS rather than confabulates.
For real numbers, run against a proper benchmark:
AVeriTeC   https://fever.ai/dataset/averitec.html   (closest fit: real claims + web evidence)
Use --dataset to point the harness at any JSON with {claim, label} records.
